notes:
- Account: internal research portal for sell-side research + compliance search. Primary users: research analysts (200), compliance reviewers (40), developer platform team (8).
- Preferred deployment: dedicated capacity in customer VPC (want predictable throughput for end-of-day batching + low-latency queries). Strong ask for customer-managed KMS + US residency.
- Scale: initial index ~10M documents (PDFs, time-series CSVs, analyst notes) -> ~200M passages after chunking. Expected growth 2x/yr.
- Performance targets: p95 query latency <= 200ms (interactive research), tail latency mitigations required. Throughput: 120 qps peak for morning digest; offline batch reranks 5k q/day. Cost sensitivity: target < $0.01/query end-to-end; looking for batching + caching recommendations.
- Models / retrieval plan: embedding candidates: open Llama2-embedding variants or curated open embeddings. Rerank: BERT-style cross-encoder for top-50, or distilled re-ranker to balance cost. Want automatic fallback to cheaper model when Dedicated burst unavailable.
- Data/security: absolute requirement for KMS integration (customer keys), audit log export to Splunk, 7-year retention for audit trails, SSO via SAML, iso27001 preference for vendor.
- POC asks: 1) indexing throughput test (parallel ingest, dedupe), 2) qps-latency profile over noisy queries, 3) rerank accuracy comparison (MRR metrics) across model variants, 4) cost model with batching + cache enabled.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We cannot afford query unpredictability during earnings season — deterministic latency is the dealbreaker."
- Internal champion: Head of Research Ops (Emily Park). Procurement lead: James McConnell.
- Notes from 2026-02-25 demo: Redwood streaming + fallbacks demoed; SE showed autoscale + cache policy. Positive reaction to console telemetry (per-route cost breakdown).
- Open items: legal needs KMS addendum draft; security requests penetration test schedule; enterprise SSO metadata exchange pending.
- Quick wins identified: use prefix KV cache for recurring research digests; precompute embeddings for nightly ingest; recommend quantized reranker for cost savings.
